srs: The volunteer scheduling system records Volunteer, Shift, SchedulingService, and Activity; each has an id attribute. Each Volunteer can have zero or more Shift records, and each Shift belongs to exactly one Volunteer. Each Shift uses exactly one SchedulingService, and each SchedulingService serves zero or more Shift records. Each SchedulingService manages one or more Activity records by composition, and each Activity belongs to exactly one SchedulingService. Each Volunteer can reference zero or more Activity records, and each Activity can be referenced by zero or more Volunteer records.
